items.problem: SystemMediaTransportControls.GetForCurrentView() has no replacement in the migration skill, so the agent left it un-migrated (try/catch -> null), producing a dead feature and a WUI0004 warning.
items.evidence: build-output.txt final line: 'warning WUI0004: SystemMediaTransportControls.GetForCurrentView() is UWP-only — use HWND-based COM interop in WinUI 3'. MainPage.xaml.cs L88-95 (try { GetForCurrentView() } catch { null }). session-log L2550-2557, L3893-3894.
items.root_cause: The #getforcurrentview replacement table enumerates ApplicationView, UIViewSettings, DisplayInformation, CoreApplication, SystemNavigationManager but omits SystemMediaTransportControls, and no HWND-interop snippet for it exists anywhere in the skill. The inventory correctly injected a TODO to the anchor, but the anchor had no answer to copy.
items.proposed_fix: Add a SystemMediaTransportControls.GetForCurrentView() row to the #getforcurrentview table mapping to ISystemMediaTransportControlsInterop.GetForWindow(hwnd), plus a short code snippet showing WindowNative.GetWindowHandle(App.MainWindow) -> As<ISystemMediaTransportControlsInterop>().GetForWindow(hwnd, iid). This is the same window-scoped-interop shape already documented for pickers.
items.generalizes: SystemMediaTransportControls is used by every UWP media playback/recording sample (audio/video players, capture apps). GetForCurrentView() for it always breaks the same way on WinUI 3 desktop, so a canonical replacement recurs broadly.

items.problem: The WUI0004 documentation row is mislabeled as SystemNavigationManager-specific and gives only a vague fix, so an agent that hits WUI0004 for a different API (e.g. SystemMediaTransportControls) finds no concrete replacement.
items.evidence: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md L584: '| WUI0004 | SystemNavigationManager.GetForCurrentView() is UWP-only | Drop the system back button hookup, or use HWND-based COM interop...'. Actual warning in build-output.txt fired for SystemMediaTransportControls, not SystemNavigationManager.
items.wrong_text_if_any: | `WUI0004` | `SystemNavigationManager.GetForCurrentView() is UWP-only` | Drop the system back button hookup, or use HWND-based COM interop; see "GetForCurrentView Replacements" above. |
items.root_cause: WUI0004 is a general 'view-scoped GetForCurrentView() is UWP-only' rule covering multiple singletons; the row hard-codes one example as if it were the whole rule, so the reader does not realize it applies to other APIs and does not look up the right replacement.
items.proposed_fix: Reword the WUI0004 symptom to '<any view-scoped>.GetForCurrentView() is UWP-only (SystemNavigationManager, SystemMediaTransportControls, ...)' and point the fix at the #getforcurrentview table for the specific API's replacement.
items.generalizes: WUI0004 will fire for whichever GetForCurrentView() singleton a given app uses; a rule-level (not example-level) description routes any future scenario to the correct replacement.
